answer: Duplicate identities create hollow accounts that cannot reuse prior solutions, since every cipher is seeded per-epoch and per-key. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work staking: each agent must burn compute to solve a unique cipher challenge derived from its reputation slot, then lock a bond in a shared vault. Forging N sybils costs N times the full bond plus wasted compute, making mass identity farming economically irrational while honest participants recover their stake. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
